lessons.title: Explore the workshop
lessons.controls:
W A S D   Walk
Mouse   Look
Shift   Sprint    Space   Jump    Ctrl / C   Crouch
lessons.text: Walk with W, A, S and D, and look around with the mouse. Hold Shift to walk faster. Space jumps, and Control crouches. The large table holds your loose parts; the lifts hold the engine and smaller assemblies.

lessons.title: Collect and carry parts
lessons.controls:
Left click / E   Pick up one part
Click another matching part   Add one to inventory
G   Put down the held part
lessons.text: Aim at a loose part and click to pick it up. Click another matching part to carry several of the same type, one pickup at a time. The inventory shows the quantity. Different sizes of screw cannot share that stack. Press G to put down the held part.

lessons.title: Fit a part
lessons.controls:
Easy   Pick up, aim at the visible ghost, click
Q   Carry / placement mode in Medium and Hard
T   Move / rotate    Hold right mouse   Adjust
lessons.text: In Easy difficulty, pick up the part, aim at its visible ghost, and click to fit it. Medium and Hard also use Q to switch between carrying and placement. In placement mode, hold the right mouse button to adjust the part. T switches between moving and rotating. Hard requires the correct orientation.

lessons.title: Raise, lower and flip
lessons.controls:
Hold the red lever + drag up / down
Red FLIP button / F   Turn the selected workpiece
Left / Right   Select lift    Up / Down   Lift height
lessons.text: Point at a lift's red lever, hold the left mouse button, and drag up or down to change its height. Release to stop. Press the red flip button to turn that lift's assembly over. The hatch opens while the assembly turns below the floor. Follow a flip instruction before fitting the next part.

lessons.title: Choose your help
lessons.controls:
V   Direction arrow    H   Ghost hints
R   Replay narration    P   Show / hide captions
N   Install next part    Tab   Chapters    Esc   Pause
lessons.text: V toggles the arrow to the next part, then its fitting position after pickup. H toggles ghost hints. R replays the current explanation. N installs the next part for you. Tab opens chapters, and Escape pauses the workshop. Settings contains volume, placement difficulty and the full controls.

lessons.title: Choose your workspace
lessons.controls:
Allow camera access
Scan a clear, well-lit surface
Tap PLACE ENGINE when a surface is found
lessons.text: Allow camera access, then move the phone slowly over a clear, well-lit surface. Tap Place Engine when a surface is found. The engine floats at working height. If AR is unavailable, choose phone view to use the same assembly without a camera.

lessons.title: Select, then fit
lessons.controls:
Bottom cards   Choose the next loose part
Visible glowing target   Tap to install
Complete one piston before starting another
lessons.text: Choose a part from the cards at the bottom, then tap its visible glowing target to fit it. Cards follow the assembly order and disappear after placement. Any piston may be started first, but finish that piston before starting another. Smaller assemblies have separate workspaces beside the engine.

lessons.title: Move the active build
lessons.controls:
One finger   Rotate
Two fingers   Move across the view
Pinch   Zoom
lessons.text: Drag with one finger to rotate the active build. Drag with two fingers to move it across the view, or pinch to zoom. Only the assembly you are working on moves. Turn it until the target is visible; phone assembly works in any orientation and never requires a lift flip.

lessons.title: Help when you need it
lessons.controls:
ARROW   Toggle the direction guide
NEXT STEP   Install the next component
CHAPTERS   Choose a section
lessons.text: Use the Arrow button to point out the next part or fitting position. Next Step fits the next component for you. Captions explain the part and its function while narration plays. Chapters lets you revisit any section with earlier work already assembled.

lessons.title: Explore in VR
lessons.controls:
Left stick   Walk
Right stick left / right   Turn
Right stick forward, aim, release   Teleport
lessons.text: Move within your safe play area, or use the left stick to walk. Push the right stick left or right to turn in steps. Push it forward to aim a teleport arc, then release to travel to the marked clear floor. The controller ray points at menu cards; press the trigger to choose one.

lessons.title: Pick up and fit
lessons.controls:
Point + hold grip   Carry a part
Aim at its visible ghost + trigger   Guided placement
Release grip   Put the part down
lessons.text: Point at a loose part and hold the grip button to carry it. Aim at the matching visible ghost and press the trigger for guided placement. Release the grip to put a loose part down. Each controller carries one part. Finish the active piston before starting another piston.

lessons.title: Operate a lift
lessons.controls:
Near the red lever   Hold grip and move up / down
Release   Stop the lift
Touch the red FLIP button / aim + trigger   Flip
lessons.text: Reach for the red lift lever, hold the grip, and move the controller up or down to raise or lower its assembly. Release the grip to stop. Touch the red flip button, or point at it and press the trigger, to turn that assembly over. Each panel operates its own lift.

lessons.title: Guidance and chapters
lessons.controls:
A / X   Install the next component
Left menu button   Pause and open chapters
Controller ray + trigger   Select a menu card
lessons.text: The captions and narration explain what each part does and where it fits. Press A or X to install the next part automatically. The left controller menu button opens the pause menu, where you can choose chapters, adjust settings, or return to the main menu.

lessons.title: Walk around the garage
lessons.controls:
Left joystick   Walk
Drag the free view   Look
On-screen crouch / sprint / jump controls
lessons.text: Use the left joystick to walk around the garage. Drag on a clear area of the view to look around. The on-screen controls let you crouch, sprint and jump. Tap a part or lift control directly to interact with it.

lessons.title: Carry and place
lessons.controls:
Tap a part   Pick up one
Tap another matching part   Add one to inventory
Tap its visible ghost   Install
lessons.text: Tap a loose part to pick it up. Tap matching parts one at a time to carry several in the inventory. Tap the matching visible ghost to fit the correct part. Complete one piston before starting the next. The captions describe the part's purpose and fitting position.

lessons.title: Use the workshop lifts
lessons.controls:
Hold the red lever + drag up / down
Tap the red FLIP button   Turn that assembly
Chapters / pause controls   Choose sections and settings
lessons.text: Hold a lift's red lever and drag up or down to change its height. Release to stop. Tap the red flip button when the narration asks you to turn the assembly over. Open chapters to choose a different section, or pause to adjust volume and placement difficulty.

lessons.title: Explore how the engine works
lessons.controls:
INFO / TIMELINE   Inspect parts or play the build
ENGINE MOTION   Watch the moving mechanism
Audio and speed controls   Choose your playback
lessons.text: In the display experience, choose Info and Timeline to inspect a part or play the assembly sequence. Engine Motion shows the working mechanism and its four strokes. The audio toggle silences timeline descriptions when you want faster playback. Assembly speed controls how quickly parts enter their fitted positions.
